verdict.rationale: TaxJar has a documented public REST API. The docs cover API-key auth, version headers, and a sandbox endpoint, and the API handles rates, calculations, transactions, nexus regions and address validation. Official clients exist in seven languages, and the first-party GitHub repo maps methods to API docs. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use our API to get information on sales tax rates, categories or upload transactions.
TaxJar uses API keys to allow access to the API.
You’ll learn how to set up the API client, authenticate with TaxJar, and make common requests using our sales tax API such as sales tax calculations and pushing transactions into TaxJar.

We currently provide API clients for the following languages: Ruby Sales Tax API, Python Sales Tax API, PHP Sales Tax API, Node Sales Tax API, C# / .NET Sales Tax API, Java Sales Tax API, Go Sales Tax API
